name: Vanilla Finest Helper
description: Small fixes and tweaks for the Vanilla Finest modpacks. Iris: turns Improved Transparency (Fabulous graphics on 1.21.1) back on when shaders are disabled, and on 26.3 fixes the enchantment glint crash. Better Clouds: toggle key, automatic Mellow cloud preset, clouds hidden behind Voxy terrain. Voxy (26.2+): keeps Vulkan selected and switches Voxy off for that session. Each part only runs when its mod is installed.
